card.name: Digits in upper end of ranges
card.fires_on: A digit inside the second number of a numeric range, after a dash or 'to' (e.g. 50-80, 85 and 125, 25-75). It marks the upper bound being written out.

modes.label: Dose or lab ranges
modes.description: Digit in the upper number of a range of doses, concentrations or counts.
modes.example: patients were dosed to a clinical response with a trough plasma concentration between 85 and 1<<2>>5 mcg/mL

modes.label: General ranges
modes.description: Digit in the upper number of a range in non-medical text such as years, percent or prices.
modes.example: The traditional internal combustion engine is only about 25%-<<3>>0% efficient at the flywheel.

card.plain: It lights up on the digits of the second number when a text gives a range like 50 to 75.
